headline: The owner question is UNANSWERABLE in most cells. 4 of 25 scored cells clear their own MDE95, against 1.25 expected by construction at alpha 0.05. The GLOBAL head-to-head is itself not resolvable (d_rho -0.02728, MDE95 0.03575). Archetype heterogeneity does not reject one common difference (Cochran Q p 0.2271, label permutation p 0.2164, I2 27.7 percent). All six cohort-weight arms lose to equal weight, random cohort labels do no worse (permutation p 0.4876), and the in-sample global oracle gain 0.00096 sits below the 0.0068 ship gate, so estimation error is not the binding constraint. No weight ships and none should.

basis.dedup_rule: one row per player, latest PRE-DEBUT read; identical rule to source_backtest.py:952-967
basis.estimand: d_rho = rho_fangraphs - rho_mlb_pipeline; negative means MLB Pipeline orders the cell better
basis.uncertainty: player bootstrap B=2000, seed 20260809; mde95 = 1.96 * sd(bootstrap d_rho); answerable when abs(d_rho) >= mde95
basis.reproduces: data/source_backtest.json accuracy.by_archetype per-source spearman, asserted in test_source_cohort_accuracy.py

reproduction.note: Leg 1 recomputes source_backtest._archetype_accuracy on this lane's rows and is binding. Leg 2 compares to the served artifact and is informational, because the served artifact can predate its own inputs.

SP.note: degenerate cell: a rank correlation is undefined on these rows

other.note: n below the 40-row floor ARCH_MIN_N sets; not scored

accuracy.by_position_group_selection_caveat: SP, RP, SIRP and MIRP are FanGraphs-authored role designations. Conditioning the pitcher cells on them conditions on one grader's own judgment, which is not a neutral partition of the population. The RP cell is 27.0 percent debuted, so the tag is projected role, not realized role. Read the RP result as a cut defined by FanGraphs rather than as a fact about relief prospects. Non-pitcher cells (C, IF, OF) do not carry this problem.

60+.note: n below the 40-row floor ARCH_MIN_N sets; not scored

accuracy.by_fv_tier_range_restriction_warning: SCIENTIFICALLY WEAK, emitted with the warning attached rather than omitted. The tier is a bin on the CONSENSUS, which is a function of BOTH graders, so within a tier the two grades are nearly equal by construction. That is range restriction, and it drives every within-tier rho toward zero: observed range -0.0851 to 0.2647 against a pooled 0.2745 / 0.3018. Do not read these cells as evidence about tier-specific accuracy.

level_at_grading.note: LEVEL AT GRADING DOES NOT EXIST on this data. snapshots carries no level column, statlines holds only season 2026, and timeseries current_level is a TODAY value whose use would leak post-grading development into a preseason cut. Age at grading (base year minus birth year) is the substitute. No level cut is invented.

selection_model.why_not: the cut rows carry ZERO paired contrast: no second source graded them, so they contain no information about d_rho under any model that does not assume the missingness is ignorable. The mean-grade imbalance between kept and cut rows makes that assumption not credible. Naming the exclusion and publishing its size IS the honest form of recovering this evidence.

multiplicity.survivors_overlap_note: The survivors are largely THE SAME PLAYERS seen through 2 partitions: a high-school arm is a draft-HS row and sits in a young age bucket. 2 survivors is not 2 independent findings.

archetype_heterogeneity.reading: Q p and the label permutation are the family-level test. A survivor count is not one: 40 cells at alpha 0.05 produce about 2 false positives by construction.

base_year_stability.note: d_rho on the pooled common set, one entry per base vintage, same two sources throughout. The sign is the quantity a cohort weight would have to be stable in.

cohort_ab.vintage_rule: weights for board year Y use base years <= Y - 3 only

permutation_control.permuted: cohort labels across rows, weights refit per draw
permutation_control.reading: p is the share of RANDOM cohort labelings that match or beat the real one. Above 0.5 means random labels do better.

shrink_sensitivity.reading: Improvement as k grows toward equal weight is the signature of zero signal: the best amount of the weight is none of it. The two estimands trend in OPPOSITE directions here, and the whole grid spans about 1e-3 against a 0.0068 gate, so neither trend is a result on its own.

alpha_parameterisation.definition: alpha = w_fg / (w_fg + w_mp); a two-source blend depends only on this ratio
alpha_parameterisation.note: The clamp is stored in weight space and nowhere translated. In alpha space it is the interval recorded here, which is what actually bounds the blend.

ab_pooled.geometry_note: Two near-collinear predictors of similar scale have a nearly flat response surface in the mixing weight. A flat oracle is GEOMETRY, not sample size, and more base years cannot change it. Where the cohort oracle scores NEGATIVE pooled while every within-cohort oracle is non-negative, cohort-specific mixing has broken the global comparability of consensus FV faster than it bought within-cohort ordering.

precision_label_free.basis: player-year rows, ALL snapshots (no preseason window), per-(source, year) mean centering

intercept_absorption.why: a_s is a free per-source intercept. Without per-(source, year) centering a source that rebases its published scale between vintages has the rebase read as variance.

precision_label_free.gls_weight_form: w_s proportional to b_s / sigma_s^2, NOT 1 / sigma_s^2. The naive inverse variance rewards range compression: a source that publishes a narrow range has a small b_s AND a small raw variance, so inverse variance upweights the source expressing the least information.

sheppard.why_not: the served aggregator observes the QUANTIZED grade, so lattice noise is real noise in the quantity being combined

two_source_identification.why: two sources give three second moments (two variances, one covariance) against four unknowns (b_1, b_2, sigma_1, sigma_2). Any split of the shared variance fits. No number is attached to the two-source case.

vintage_availability.structural_note: A precision weight for board year Y is vintage-legal only when an estimable year sits at or before Y - 3. The A/B can only score board years whose outcomes have resolved. Those two sets do not intersect, so the label-free route cannot be validated against an outcome on this data at all. STRUCTURAL, not a power problem: no number of extra players changes it.

espn.why_no_weight: range restriction deflates variance and covariance in OPPOSITE directions relative to the factor model, so a triad solved with this instrument in it is biased in a direction the triad cannot detect from within

six_source_covariance_diagnostic.reading: Pairwise-complete covariance is not constrained to be PSD when the pairs come from different populations. Whether or not an eigenvalue goes negative, the swap table is the binding evidence: if the six series were reads of ONE latent variable on ONE population, b_fangraphs would not depend on which instrument completes the triad.

precision_vs_accuracy.reading: Precision and accuracy are uncorrelated across archetypes. Where accuracy IS resolvable, precision does not point the same way, so a precision weight would have been wrong exactly where it mattered. alpha_fg above 0.5 means precision prefers FanGraphs; d_rho below 0 means accuracy prefers MLB Pipeline.

reasons: Lane M4 (2026-08-08) measured coverage dependence at p 0.048 pre-shrinkage and p 0.944 post-shrinkage: the incumbent SINGLE_SOURCE_K=0.5 already absorbs it.
lambda_k is a continuous-in-k reparameterisation of the SAME estimand M4 already tested, not a new one.
its proposed interaction gate needs roughly n=2000 in the k=1 stratum; the outcome-resolvable window supplies 500.
its input sigma_pub has no vintage estimate before 2023, so it cannot be computed on any year the A/B can score.

calibration_drift.note: Offsets are on same-quarter common slots against the reference, so a move is a scale change and not a coverage change. grade_normalization absorbs the level shift per cycle; nothing DETECTS it. This is the most likely future silent-corruption vector for the consensus.
